acceptance_criteria.description: summarize returns correct dict for empty, header-only, CRLF, BOM, quoted commas/escaped quotes, empty records, verbatim categories, summed repeats
summarize raises ValueError for bad header, malformed quoting, stray quotes, wrong field count, negative/whitespace/non-ASCII/non-digit counts
CLI prints sorted-keys JSON plus single newline on success, exits 2 with empty stdout on invalid input/usage error
python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passes including new regression tests

assumptions: Preserve summarize(text:str)->dict[str,int] and python3.12 cli.py INPUT.csv entry points
Preserve category text verbatim; no implementation until human approval
discoveries: csv_summary.py:4-13 splitlines+split(',')+int() breaks quoted commas/escaped quotes, ignores CRLF/BOM, int() allows whitespace/+/unicode digits
goal: Fix CSV summary API and CLI per contract, preserve entry points, add focused public regression tests
risks: csv.reader strict mode plus utf-8-sig BOM handling and empty-record skip must be exact
Count validation must use ASCII regex ^[0-9]+$ not int()
CLI must buffer output for atomic stdout with exact sorted JSON plus newline

steps.instructions: Rewrite summarize using csv.reader(strict=True) over text split with BOM strip, exact header category,count check, skip empty records, enforce 2 fields per record, validate count with ^[0-9]+$ then int, sum by verbatim category, ValueError otherwise.

steps.title: Harden CLI atomic output and exit codes

steps.instructions: Add tests/test_regression.py covering BOM, CRLF, quoted comma/escaped quote, empty/header-only/empty-record, repeated sum, and each ValueError class plus CLI success/failure stdout/exit checks.
steps.title: Add focused regression tests

steps.instructions: Run full verification, report results, make no code changes in this step.
